02 · Business Case
Verisk Core Business Friction

Expanding Network

Verisk's Property Estimating Network is rapidly expanding through the AccuLynx acquisition, aiming to connect insurers, contractors, adjusters, and policyholders on one cohesive workflow.

Fragmented Visibility

Support reps cannot see a unified view of claim status, property estimates, or weather data. Information is split across legacy PES, AccuLynx, and third-party feeds.

The Bottleneck

This disconnect directly results in slow claim cycle times. Policyholders and insurers are left waiting due to the manual overhead of traversing multiple disparate platforms.

CDO-Level Risk

Slow claims resolution directly drives churn risk with insurer clients who demand rapid execution.

A Path Forward
Three Personas, One Unified System
Architectural Invariant: Persona-scoped access enforced at the data graph layer — not just superficial UI controls.
👤

Claimant

  • Track Status: Real-time progress updates
  • Upload Evidence: Submit photo/document files
  • Guidance: Instant resolution of policy queries
🔧

Contractor

  • Scope Review: Inspect allocated claim files
  • Work Orders: Submit milestone field logs
  • Invoicing: Post job billing packets directly
📋

Adjuster

  • Portfolio View: Full book of assigned claims
  • Dispatch: Generate and assign work orders
  • Approve: Authorize contractor repair invoices

Resilience & Guardrails
The Riskiest Assumption: External API Failure
"Can the agent reliably merge external live weather data with the claim profile, and return coherent answers — without hallucinating status or estimates when the external API is degraded?"

✅ Happy Path Execution

Agent queries Data 360 profile + NOAA weather feed + AccuLynx estimate. Synthesizes a structured response with explicit source attribution tags on each data point.

⚠️ Failure Path — API 503 Outage

Agent returns deterministic fallback: "Weather data currently unavailable." Zero hallucination guaranteed via two-layer guardrail: prompt constraint + hardcoded circuit-breaker bypass.

Guardrail Enforcement: System Prompt Directive + Deterministic Code Bypass (Circuit Breaker)

06 · Business Outcomes
Verisk Claims Concierge AI
Key Takeaways

Data 360 Foundation

Harmonizes PES + AccuLynx into unified claim profiles. Federates external weather context. Resolves contractor identity across product silos.

LangGraph Agent

Grounds every response in Data 360 context. Persona-scoped permissions. Standard assisted workflow with graceful degradation built in.

Business Impact

Single pane of glass for all claim actors. Accelerated cycle turnaround. Measurable churn risk reduction for Verisk subscription accounts.

06 · Execution Handoff
Execution Handoff: PoC to Production
01

Identity Hardening

Full automated reconciliation rules and exception queues at scale. Move from prototype SQLite to production Data Cloud profiles.

02

Agentforce Migration

Map LangGraph nodes to standard Agentforce Actions. Map persona permission guards to Agentforce scopes and topic routing.

03

Data 360 Wiring

Replace SQLite prototype with native Data Cloud unified profiles and data graph objects. Full zero-copy federation for weather data.

04

Evaluation Pipeline

Source attribution logging, weekly golden dataset reviews, response quality scoring, and continuous grounding validation.

LangGraph topology maps 1:1 into Agentforce: Nodes → Standard Actions, State → Data Cloud Grounding.
